raw_context:
Tivity Health
does not manufacture or sell physical goods or consumer products
. Instead, it is a fitness and health administration company that provides network-based wellness, physical medicine, and digital health programs through partnerships with health plans and employers.
MarketScreener India
Core Tivity Health Programs & Networks
SilverSneakers
: A fitness and mental wellbeing program designed for older adults and provided through Medicare Advantage and group retiree plans.
Prime Fitness
: A nationwide fitness facility network that includes national brands, regional chains, and independent local gyms.
ForeverFit
: A flexible fitness benefit designed for employers and commercial health plans.
WholeHealth Living
: A specialized network of alternative and physical medicine providers like chiropractors and physical therapists.
Burnalong
: A digital health and wellness platform offering live and on-demand classes across multiple categories.
PR Newswire
(Note: Tivity Health previously owned the consumer nutrition brands
Nutrisystem
and
South Beach Diet
, but completely sold off that nutrition division in late 2020.)
